title: Palindrome Check
description:
# Palindrome Check

A **palindrome** reads the same forwards and backwards. Read a line and print `YES` if it is a palindrome (ignoring letter case), or `NO` otherwise.

## Input

A single line of text.

## Output

`YES` or `NO`.

```
Input:
Racecar

Output:
YES
```

## Think about

- Compare the string to its reverse.
- `Racecar` should count as a palindrome, so case shouldn't matter.
starterCode:
s = input()

# TODO: print YES if s is a palindrome (ignoring case), else NO
hints: Compare the string to its reverse.
Lowercase the string, then check whether it equals its reverse (`s == s[::-1]`).

```
t = lowercase(s)
i = 0;  j = length(t)-1
while i < j
    if t[i] != t[j]
        print "NO" and stop
    i = i + 1;  j = j - 1
print "YES"
```
